mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.asgn_no,a.dev_id,d.dev_nm,d.mng_no,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm, a.job_cd,coalesce(j.cd_nm,a.job_cd) AS job_nm,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,a.plan_end_dt, a.ext_psblty_cd,coalesce(e.cd_nm,'미정') AS ext_psblty_nm,a.asgn_stts_cd, coalesce(a.updated_at,a.created_at) AS updated_at, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EXTEND' AND h.fixed_yn='N') AS extend_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='EARLY_END' AND h.fixed_yn='N') AS early_end, (SELECT rd.dev_nm FROM asgn.asgn_chg_hist h JOIN asgn.asgn r ON r.asgn_id=h.new_asgn_id JOIN mst.dev rd ON rd.dev_id=r.dev_id WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.asgn_chg_ty_cd='REPLACE' AND h.fixed_yn='N' ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.asgn_chg_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS replacement_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.use_yn, (SELECT min(x.bgn_dt) FROM asgn.asgn x WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.prj_id=a.prj_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED') AS dispatch_first_dt, n.asgn_id AS next_asgn_id,np.prj_nm AS next_prj_nm,n.bgn_dt AS next_bgn_dt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=a.job_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl e ON e.cd_grp_id='EXT_POSSIBILITY' AND e.dtl_cd=a.ext_psblty_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.asgn_id,x.prj_id,x.bgn_dt FROM asgn.asgn x WHERE x.dev_id=a.dev_id AND x.asgn_id!=a.asgn_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND x.end_dt>a.end_dt ORDER BY x.bgn_dt,x.asgn_id LIMIT 1 ) n ON true LEFT JOIN prj.prj np ON np.prj_id=n.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd IN ('ACTIVE','REPLACED') ORDER BY a.asgn_id
